faq.question: What does Syahmi mean?
faq.answer: Syahmi is associated with the Arabic form شَهْمِي, whose core sense is syahmi; of noble character (malay form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Syahmi?
faq.answer: Syahmi is associated with Arabic. Syahmi is the Malay form of Arabic شَهْمِيّ (Shahmī), the relative form of شَهَامَة (nobility), used as a male given name.

faq.question: Is Syahmi an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form شَهْمِي is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Syahmi an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Syahmi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Syahmi a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Syahmi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Shahmī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.question: What does Syahmi mean in Persian?
faq.answer: In Persian, Syahmi is rendered شهمی and carries the sense شهمی، شجاع.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Syahmi, syahmi. Script forms are شهمي, شهمی, شَهْمِي, شہمی, शहमी.
